WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%seattle%' LIMIT 1))
  AND leisure = 'common'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT park_name, ST_Area(geometry::geography) AS area
FROM parks
WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%united states%' LIMIT 1))
  AND leisure = 'recreation_ground'
ORDER BY area DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT lake_name
FROM lakes
WHERE ST_Intersects(lakes.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry::geography FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Eaton%' LIMIT 1))
  AND water = 'reservoir'
ORDER BY ST_Area(lakes.geometry::geography) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```

```sql
SELECT park_name
FROM parks
WHERE leisure = 'nature_reserve'
  AND ST_Intersects(parks.geometry::geography, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Virginia%' LIMIT 1))
ORDER BY ST_Area(parks.geometry::geography) DESC
LIMIT 1;
```
